neighbours.label: degree words saying an effect is non-trivial, especially '-fully' adverbs like 'meaningfully'/'usefully' and 'appreciable', 'clinically significant'
fire: None of the reforms has meaningfully improved wages for nurses.
These two measurements cannot be usefully combined into one score.
The tax did not appreciably change how much people drove.
Only a few of the trials found clinically significant benefits.
It is hard to see how the policy meaningfully helps renters.
The forest has not recovered in any appreciable way since the fire.
Such small samples cannot be meaningfully analysed by region.
